=INSERT INTO "Product" (
  proveedor,
  ref_proveedor,
  ref_variante,
  ean,
  name,
  slug,
  marca,
  images,
  categoria_texto,
  categoria_padre,
  color,
  talla,
  stock,
  published,
  activo,
  visible_web,
  "createdAt",
  "updatedAt"
) VALUES (
  '{{ $json.proveedor }}',
  '{{ $json.ref_proveedor }}',
  {{ $json.ref_variante ? "'" + $json.ref_variante + "'" : "NULL" }},
  {{ $json.ean ? "'" + $json.ean + "'" : "NULL" }},
  '{{ $json.name.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.slug }}',
  {{ $json.marca ? "'" + $json.marca.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : "NULL" }},
  {{ $json.imagen ? "ARRAY['" + $json.imagen + "']::text[]" : "ARRAY[]::text[]" }},
  {{ $json.categoria ? "'" + $json.categoria.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : "NULL" }},
  {{ $json.categoria_padre ? "'" + $json.categoria_padre.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : "NULL" }},
  {{ $json.color ? "'" + $json.color + "'" : "NULL" }},
  {{ $json.talla ? "'" + $json.talla + "'" : "NULL" }},
  {{ $json.stock }},
  {{ $json.published }},
  {{ $json.activo }},
  {{ $json.visible_web }},
  NOW(),
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (proveedor, ref_proveedor, ref_variante)
DO UPDATE SET
  ean = EXCLUDED.ean,
  name = EXCLUDED.name,
  slug = EXCLUDED.slug,
  marca = EXCLUDED.marca,
  images = EXCLUDED.images,
  categoria_texto = EXCLUDED.categoria_texto,
  categoria_padre = EXCLUDED.categoria_padre,
  color = EXCLUDED.color,
  talla = EXCLUDED.talla,
  stock = EXCLUDED.stock,
  activo = EXCLUDED.activo,
  visible_web = EXCLUDED.visible_web,
  "updatedAt" = NOW();
